card.name: Dosing-section terms before qualifiers
card.fires_on: Words in dosing and patient-selection text just before a qualifier, such as an opening parenthesis after severe hepatic impairment, the word for in a dosage heading, or a gene name before exon.

modes.label: Parenthesis after impairment
modes.description: The open parenthesis after severe hepatic impairment, just before the Child-Pugh class.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of LORBRENA for patients with severe hepatic impairment<< (>>Child-Pugh C) is 5

modes.label: Heading and gene words
modes.description: A word in a dosage heading or a gene name that leads into the condition or alteration.
modes.example: 2.3 Dosage<< for>> Irritable Bowel Syndrome with Diarr

modes.label: Inside technical terms
modes.description: A piece within an enzyme name or a lab-test phrase.
modes.example: Consider testing for thiopurine S-methyltransfer<<ase>> (TPMT) or nucleotide d
